overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（4 篇）、资产定价（1 篇）。方法上以机器学习、数值模拟为主。来源分布：arXiv（8 篇）、OpenAlex（4 篇）。

papers.title: Large language models as a decision-making core for semantic capability check in asset administration shell-based intelligent manufacturing
papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Flexible manufacturing and lot-size-one production require deciding, at run time, whether an available resource can perform a required operation. The IDTA 02020 Capability Description submodel standardizes how asset capabilities are represented in the Asset Administration Shell (AAS), but it provides no mechanism to reason over and compare them. This article investigates the use of a Large Language Model (LLM) as the decision-making core of a capability-matching procedure that operates directly over this standardized submodel, without shared ontologies. The approach is evaluated under the variability with which the same capability can be described in the AAS, across sixteen test cases spanning four abstraction dimensions and two degrees of semantic formalism. Process-level semantic alignment, anchored in the DIN 8580 taxonomy, was correct in all cases and indifferent to the degree of formalism of the description, whereas requirement verification under a conservative aggregation policy rejected every positive case while producing no false positives. The analysis traces this systematic rejection to a single, correctable cause: a boundary that the standardized submodel does not disambiguate — between properties that constitute requirements to be proven and properties that merely describe the product. The contribution is therefore less the aggregate verdict than the localization of the layer at which LLM-based matching over the standardized submodel is reliable and the precise mechanism by which it fails, together with the modeling and prompting strategies that follow from this diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
灵活制造和单件生产模式要求在运行时判断现有资源是否能够执行所需的操作。IDTA 02020能力描述子模型规范了如何在资产管理系统（Asset Administration Shell，AAS）中表示资产能力，但该模型并未提供用于推理和比较这些能力的机制。本文探讨了将大型语言模型（Large Language Model，LLM）作为能力匹配流程的核心决策工具的应用，该流程直接基于这一标准化子模型进行操作，无需依赖共享的本体。研究通过十六个测试案例评估了该方法的性能，这些测试案例涵盖了四个抽象维度和两种语义形式化程度。基于DIN 8580分类法的过程级语义对齐在所有情况下均正确无误，且与描述的形式化程度无关；而采用保守的聚合策略进行需求验证时，虽然所有符合要求的案例均被正确识别，但未出现任何误判。分析发现这种系统性误判的原因在于标准化子模型未能明确区分两类属性：一类是需被验证的需求属性，另一类仅仅是描述产品的属性。因此，本文的贡献不仅在于对LLM在标准化子模型上匹配能力的可靠性进行评估，还在于精确指出了其失效的具体机制，以及基于这一诊断结果所提出的建模和提示策略。。研究方法：大语言模型。

papers.title: From data to decisions: A narrative review of business intelligence and predictive analytics framework for enhancing SME competitiveness and economic resilience in the United States
papers.venue: Magna Scientia Advanced Research and Reviews
papers.abstract: Small and medium-sized (SME) business organizations constitute the structural foundation of the United States economy but are systematically under-served by advanced business intelligence (BI) and predictive analytics infrastructure, which is structurally threatening to inclusive economic growth and resiliency. This narrative review critically summarizes peer-reviewed literature (2020-2025) to understand new trends, frameworks, and uses of BI and predictive analytics to increase U.S. SME competitiveness and economic resilience and define gaps in governance and future research priorities. The data shows that there is a paradigm shift between retrospective reporting to real-time and AI-enhanced analytics, adaptive dashboarding, cloud-based predictive models, agentic supply-chain pipelines, and machine-learning-based scenario planning are changing the operations of the SMEs. There are still critical gaps in data literacy, fair access to AI and bias in algorithms, and governance mechanisms that are tuned to the scale of SME deployment. Empirical claims across the literature vary in methodological rigor and should be viewed with proper caution before the standardized replication. Implementation science, ethical AI governance in line with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and OECD AI Principles, and SME-specific digital resilience benchmarks should be the priorities of future research to democratize data-driven decision-making in the U.S. SME sector.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】中小企业（SME）是美国经济的支柱，但在先进商业智能（BI）和预测分析基础设施方面长期处于服务不足的状态，这从结构上威胁到了经济的包容性增长和韧性。本文通过文献综述（2020-2025年）分析了BI和预测分析在提升中小企业竞争力和经济韧性方面的新趋势、框架和应用方式，并指出了治理方面的不足及未来研究重点。数据显示，分析方式正从传统的回顾性报告向实时分析和人工智能辅助分析转变；自适应仪表盘、基于云的预测模型、智能供应链管理以及基于机器学习的情景规划正在改变中小企业的运营模式。然而，在数据素养、公平获取人工智能资源以及针对中小企业规模定制的治理机制方面仍存在显著短板。现有研究在方法论严谨性上存在差异，在进行标准化复制之前需谨慎对待相关结论。未来研究应重点关注实施科学、符合NIST人工智能管理框架（AI RMF）、ISO/IEC 42001标准和经合组织人工智能原则的伦理治理机制，以及针对中小企业的数字化韧性评估体系，以推动美国中小企业领域的数据驱动决策。。

papers.title: What Useful Alphas?
papers.abstract: This paper examines about 200 published long-short anomaly equity portfolios (Chen and Zimmermann, 2022). Over the period through 2005 (December 2005 and earlier) and across all stocks, their median zero-investment return was an impressive 48 bp per month. Using only post-2005 years (January 2006 onward) reduces this to 19 bp. Using only "non-micro" top-3,000 stocks in the top 90% of market capitalization reduces this to 26 bp. Using only post-2005 and non-micro stocks reduces this to 7 bp. Even modest allowances for luck or transaction costs would have eliminated even these 7 bp. The evidence strongly suggests that published academic anomalies have been useless to non-micro-cap portfolio managers in the 21st century. Public stock markets were very efficient.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文研究了约200个已发表的长期-短期异常股票投资组合（Chen和Zimmermann，2022年）。在2005年及之前的时间段内，所有股票的投资组合每月的平均零投资回报率为48个基点（bp）。如果仅考虑2005年之后的数据（2006年1月及以后），这一回报率降至19个基点。如果进一步筛选出市值排名前90%的“非微型”股票（即非市值低于3000万美元的股票），回报率进一步降至26个基点。而如果仅使用2005年之后的“非微型”股票，回报率则降至7个基点。即使考虑到运气或交易成本的轻微影响，这些7个基点也可能消失殆尽。研究结果表明，在21世纪，已发表的学术研究中的异常现象对非微型市值股票的投资组合管理者来说几乎毫无参考价值。公开股票市场具有极高的效率。。

papers.title: The U.S. Mortality Crisis as a Preston Curve Reversal
papers.abstract: U.S. life expectancy stagnated and declined in the 2010s despite continued growth in real per capita income. We use Preston curves to characterize this pattern as a change in the relationship between income and longevity. Using state-level data from 1980 to 2019 and county-level data from 2000 to 2019, we estimate population-weighted Preston curves relating life expectancy to logged real per capita income. From 1980 to 2010, U.S. states followed the classic Preston curve pattern: rising income was accompanied by rising life expectancy. Counties followed the same pattern from 2000 to 2010. From 2010 to 2019, however, states and continued to become richer while life expectancy stagnated or declined. The curves shifted right without shifting up and became steeper, indicating decoupling and divergence: increases in aggregate resources over time no longer produced broad longevity gains, and, in any given year, inequality in life expectancy by income grew. These patterns are robust to alternative temporal anchors around the Great Recession and to substituting education for income. They also appear across sex and racial groups. County-level decompositions are broadly consistent with arguments that longevity has fallen due to widely shared exposure to social deterioration, which may account for the Preston curve reversal. Collectively, we show that the recent U.S. mortality crisis reveals a weakening -- and growing inequality -- in the conversion of aggregate resources into longevity gains. We conclude that the recent U.S. mortality crisis should be understood not only as a story about particular causes of death, but also as a weakening of institutional and social translation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】21世纪10年代，尽管美国人均实际收入持续增长，但人均预期寿命却停滞不前甚至有所下降。我们利用普雷斯顿曲线（Preston curves）来描述这种收入与寿命之间关系的变化。通过分析1980年至2019年的州级数据以及2000年至2019年的县级数据，我们得出了将预期寿命与对数化人均实际收入相关联的、基于人口加权的普雷斯顿曲线。1980年至2010年间，美国各州遵循典型的普雷斯顿曲线规律：收入增加伴随着预期寿命的延长；2000年至2010年间，各县也呈现相同趋势。然而，2010年至2019年间，尽管各州的经济继续繁荣，人均预期寿命却停滞或下降。这些曲线向右移动但并未向上移动，且斜率变得更加陡峭，表明收入与寿命之间的关联逐渐减弱并出现分化：随着时间的推移，总体资源的增加不再能够显著提升预期寿命；同时，不同收入群体之间的预期寿命差距也在扩大。这些现象在大衰退（Great Recession）前后以及用教育水平替代收入水平进行统计分析时依然存在，并且在不同性别和种族群体中均普遍观察到。县级数据的分解结果进一步支持了这样一种观点：预期寿命的下降可能与社会整体状况的恶化有关。总体而言，当前...。

papers.title: Prediction of rainfall and ore productions (ore and wastes) using multivariate time-series approach, Enyigba open pit mine Ebonyi state, Nigeria
papers.venue: World Journal of Advanced Engineering Technology and Sciences
papers.abstract: This article aimed at predicting rainfall and ore production of Eyigba open pit Mine Ebonyi State using a Multivariate Time-Series Approach. Rainfall and ore (ore, waste) production data collections, review of machine learning (ML) techniques for  rainfall and ore prediction and integrating of various techniques are few objectives of this article. The datasets are trained, fit into models, propose a model combining Seasonal and Trend Decomposition (STL), Synthetic Minority Over-Sampling Techniques (SMOTE), Random Forest (RF) and Long Term Short Memory (LSTM) in order to optimize the proposed architecture combining Seasonal Trend Decompsotion (STL), Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE), Random Forest (RF), and Long Term Short Memory (LSTM), formulate mathematical models for algorithm integration, evaluate performance of the models and their implications for mining operations. The pipeline integrates STL for preprocessing, SMOTE for data augmentation, RF for feature engineering, and LSTM networks for prediction. STL decomposes time series to mitigate seasonality, SMOTE augments underrepresented low-production events, RF selects optimal lags, and LSTM captures temporal dependencies. Performance evaluation of the multivariate model achieves an RMSE of 1,850 tons and MAPE of 8.2% for ore production, surpassing standalone RF(RMSE: 2,450 tons, MAPE: 11.5%) and univariate LSTM (RMSE: 2,120 tons, MAPE: 9.8%). These results demonstrate the framework’s ability to model rainfall-ore interactions, enabling proactive operational strategies. The performance of the models compared and concluded that the integrated LSTM outperformed other models. The findings confirmed that rainfall significantly influences ore production rates due to its impact on equipment efficiency, pit floor stability, and haulage operations.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文旨在利用多元时间序列方法预测埃博尼州Eyigba露天矿的降雨量及矿石产量。文章的主要目标包括收集降雨量和矿石（包括矿石和废料）的生产数据，研究用于降雨量和矿石预测的机器学习（ML）技术，并将这些技术进行整合。通过对数据集进行训练并构建模型，本文提出了一种结合季节性趋势分解（STL）、合成少数样本过采样技术（SMOTE）、随机森林（RF）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）的预测框架，以优化该预测模型。具体而言，该模型通过STL处理时间序列数据以减弱季节性影响，利用SMOTE技术增加产量较低的数据样本的代表性，通过RF选择最优的滞后参数，以及利用LSTM捕捉时间序列中的依赖关系。模型性能评估结果显示：该多变量模型的矿石产量预测均方根误差（RMSE）为1,850吨，平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为8.2%，优于单独使用RF（RMSE：2,450吨，MAPE：11.5%）或单变量LSTM（RMSE：2,120吨，MAPE：9.8%）。这些结果表明该框架能够有效模拟降雨量与矿石产量之间的相互作用，从而为采矿作业提供有针对性的决策支持。综合比较各模型的性能后，发现集成LSTM模型的预测效果最佳...。研究方法：时间序列、机器学习、随机森林。

papers.title: Transforming Construction Risk Management and Resource Optimization: A Machine Learning and Big Data Perspective
papers.abstract: This integrative literature review examines the role of machine learning (ML) and big data analytics in transforming risk management and resource optimization in construction projects. Following a PRISMA-P-guided search across Scopus, Google Scholar, Web of Science, and PubMed, 5,756 initial records were identified and screened, resulting in a final dataset of 154 eligible studies, of which 59 high- and moderate-quality studies were retained for detailed synthesis after quality assessment. The review highlights ML’s enhanced predictive capabilities for risk assessment and resource allocation, supported by cross-industry comparisons and construction-specific case studies. Representative findings from the literature include reported prediction accuracies of up to 93.75% for delay-risk prediction and 97.6% for equipment matching, indicating the potential of MLbased tools to improve forecasting, monitoring, and resource-allocation decisions. The review also highlights the synergistic integration of ML with Building Information Modeling (BIM), the Internet of Things (IoT), and digital twin technologies, which collectively enhance project efficiency despite challenges in data-sharing standardization, interoperability, and regulatory compliance. Key barriers to ML and big data adoption are identified, along with strategic measures to address them. The study proposes two novel frameworks for the construction sector: an AI-Enhanced Construction Risk Prediction and Mitigation Framework and a Smart Build: AI-Optimized Resource Management Framework. These frameworks, informed by insights from industry practitioners, policymakers, and researchers, aim to advance digital transformation in construction by providing structured approaches for leveraging ML in risk management and resource optimization.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】这篇综合性文献综述探讨了机器学习（ML）和大数据分析在建筑项目风险管理与资源优化中的作用。通过遵循PRISMA-P指南，在Scopus、Google Scholar、Web of Science和PubMed等数据库中进行搜索，共筛选出5,756篇初始文献，最终确定154篇符合研究要求的研究作为分析对象。经过质量评估后，其中59篇高质量和中等质量的研究被选入详细分析。综述强调了机器学习在风险评估和资源分配方面的预测能力提升，这一结论得到了跨行业比较及建筑行业具体案例研究的支持。文献中的代表性研究结果表明：机器学习在延迟风险预测方面的准确率可达到93.75%，在设备匹配方面的准确率为97.6%，表明基于机器学习的工具有助于提升预测、监控和资源分配决策的准确性。此外，综述还指出了机器学习与建筑信息模型（BIM）、物联网（IoT）和数字孪生技术的协同整合效应，这些技术尽管在数据共享标准化、互操作性和合规性方面存在挑战，但仍能共同提升项目效率。研究指出了机器学习和大数据应用面临的主要障碍，并提出了相应的应对策略。最后，该研究为建筑行业提出了两个创新框架：一个是“人工智能增强的建筑风险预测...。研究方法：机器学习、优化方法。

papers.title: A Machine-Learning-Compatible Omnibus Test for Treatment Effect Heterogeneity
papers.abstract: This study proposes a formal, computationally efficient nonparametric omnibus test for treatment-effect heterogeneity that is compatible with a broad class of estimators, including modern machine-learning methods. The test is designed for settings in which identification can rely on high-dimensional controls while heterogeneity is assessed with respect to a low-dimensional subset of covariates. We derive the test statistic's asymptotic null distribution and develop a bootstrap procedure that is efficient because it avoids re-estimating nuisance parameters in each iteration. The testing approach applies to multiple empirical designs, including randomized experiments, selection-on-observables, difference-in-differences, and instrumental-variables settings. Monte Carlo simulations show that the test attains near-nominal size under the null and exhibits good power against heterogeneous alternatives. We further illustrate the procedure using two empirical applications on retirement savings and trade liberalization.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究提出了一种形式化、计算效率高的非参数综合检验方法，用于检测治疗效果的异质性。该方法与广泛的估计量兼容，包括现代机器学习方法。该检验适用于以下情形：在能够利用高维控制变量的情况下进行识别分析，同时针对低维协变量子集来评估治疗效果的异质性。我们推导了该检验统计量的渐近零分布，并开发了一种自助法（bootstrap procedure），该方法通过避免在每次迭代中重新估计干扰参数而提高了效率。该检验方法适用于多种实证研究设计，包括随机实验、基于观测变量的选择（selection-on-observables）、差异-in-differences（DID）以及工具变量（instrumental variables）模型。蒙特卡洛模拟结果表明，在零假设下该检验的统计量大小接近名义水平，并且在面对异质性替代假设时具有较好的检验功效。我们进一步通过两个实证案例（退休储蓄和贸易自由化）对该检验方法进行了演示。。研究方法：双重差分、蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟、随机实验、实验方法。

papers.title: Error Propagation in Spectral Functionals of Shrinkage Covariance Estimators: Perturbation Bounds and Calibrated Inference
papers.abstract: Rolling covariance estimates feed two objects that are routinely treated as market structure. The first is the dominant eigenspace, monitored through the projector movement $\widehat D_{K,t}=\|\widehat P_{K,t}-\widehat P_{K,t-1}\|_F$; the second comprises scalar spectral functionals such as the absorption ratio and the leading-eigenvalue share. Both fluctuate under estimation noise, and shrinkage changes the law of that noise, so reading their movements as structural change requires calibration. For the eigenspace, we derive a first-order null law for $\widehat D_{K,t}$ between overlapping windows that share most of their data and show that it transfers without change to rotation-equivariant shrinkage estimators. A distribution-free Davis-Kahan band gauges whether the eigenspace is identified, an estimator-aware bootstrap provides the calibrated test, and a companion power analysis gives an approximate design rule for the smallest detectable rotation. For the scalar functionals, we show that first-order immunity to elliptical kurtosis holds for scale-invariant functionals and only for them, so that one estimated scalar calibrates the projector null and the absorption-ratio and leading-share intervals across the elliptical family. In high dimensions, where shrinkage cleaning biases the absorption ratio, we give a trace-preserving spike-debiased estimator that removes the bias. The results are verified by simulation under a known population covariance; an equity-panel appendix shows the procedures as diagnostics when the population is unknown.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】滚动协方差估计为两个常被视为市场结构的指标提供了数据支持。第一个指标是主导特征空间，通过投影器变化量 $\widehat D_{K,t}=\|\widehat P_{K,t}-\widehat P_{K,t-1}\|_F$ 来监测；第二个指标包括标量谱函数，如吸收比和领先特征值占比。这两个指标都会受到估计噪声的影响，而收缩方法会改变噪声的分布特性，因此将它们的变化解读为结构变化需要相应的校准。对于特征空间，我们推导出了在数据重叠的窗口之间 $\widehat D_{K,t}$ 的一阶零假设，并证明该假设在旋转不变型收缩估计器中仍然成立。一种无需依赖特定分布的Davis-Kahan区间方法可用于判断特征空间是否被正确识别；结合估计器特性的自助法（bootstrap）可以提供校准后的检验结果；此外，我们还提出了一个近似的设计规则，用于确定能够检测到的最小旋转角度。对于标量函数，我们发现只有对尺度不变函数而言，它们才具有一阶免疫性（即不受椭圆峰度（elliptical kurtosis）的影响），因此可以通过一个标量估计量来校准投影器零假设以及吸收比和领先特征值占比的置信区间。在高维情...。研究方法：数值模拟、模型校准。

papers.title: Factor-Augmented Machine Learning Panel Regressions
papers.abstract: This paper develops the asymptotic theory for high-dimensional panel data regressions in settings with cross-sectionally dependent errors driven by common shocks. We consider a factor-augmented sparse-group LASSO estimator that combines MIDAS aggregation with latent factors. The estimator can take advantage of the mixed-frequency group structure in the time-series dimension. Theory shows that it can outperform the standard LASSO estimator both for prediction and estimation while allowing for cross-sectional dependence.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】本文研究了在高维面板数据回归中的渐近理论，这些数据受到共同冲击的影响，且截面误差之间存在相关性。我们提出了一种基于因子增强技术的稀疏组LASSO估计器，该估计器结合了MIDAS聚合方法和潜在因子模型。该估计器能够充分利用时间序列维度中的混合频率分组结构。理论分析表明，在允许截面误差相关性的情况下，该估计器在预测和估计性能上均优于传统的LASSO估计器。。研究方法：面板数据、横截面分析、回归分析、LASSO 正则化。

papers.title: Entropic Dynamics of Jump-Diffusion Option Pricing
papers.abstract: Standard models of stock price dynamics and option valuation usually begin by postulating stochastic processes. This paper develops an entropic inference framework that derives these processes from information constraints. The key symmetry is that markets reward returns rather than price levels, which selects log price as the dynamical variable. Price changes are represented by two channels. The continuous channel carries constraints of continuity and directionality. The jump channel carries the arrival rate and the first two moments of jump size. Since these constraints apply to disjoint parts of the microstate, the channels factorize. The resulting dynamics is the Merton jump diffusion, with Geometric Brownian Motion as the no jump limit. The log price density satisfies the Kolmogorov Feller equation, whose no jump limit is the Fokker Planck equation. The same inferential principle, with no arbitrage imposed through the mean log return, selects the Esscher transform from the many martingale measures available in an incomplete market. The option price then satisfies Mertons partial integro differential equation, and the risk neutral mixture of lognormal distributions generates the implied volatility smile. The Black Scholes results are recovered when jumps vanish. What changes from one model to another is not the inference, but the information supplied to it.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】标准股价动态模型和期权定价模型通常从假设随机过程入手。本文构建了一个基于熵推断的框架，该框架能够从信息约束中推导出这些随机过程。其核心思想是：市场奖励的是投资回报而非价格水平，因此选择对数价格作为动态变量来描述价格变化。价格变化通过两个渠道来体现：连续性渠道反映了价格的连续性和方向性特征；跳跃渠道则包含了价格跳跃的频率以及跳跃幅度的统计特性（即第一和第二矩）。由于这些约束条件适用于微观状态的不同组成部分，因此这两个渠道可以相互独立处理。最终得到的价格动态模型为Merton跳跃扩散模型，而在无跳跃情况下该模型退化为几何布朗运动（Geometric Brownian Motion）。对数价格密度满足Kolmogorov-Feller方程，其无跳跃极限形式即为Fokker-Planck方程。同样的推断原理（通过均值对数回报来消除套利机会）用于从不完全市场中的多种鞅测度中选择合适的测度；在此基础上，期权价格遵循Merton偏微分积分方程，而对数正态分布的风险中性混合模型能够解释隐含波动率（implied volatility）的微笑效应（smile effect）。当价格跳跃消失时，模型...。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Signature-based identification of volatility models from path geometry
papers.abstract: We propose a signature-based framework for the identification of stochastic volatility model classes from observed path data. By mapping volatility trajectories into a feature space via truncated path signatures and applying a gradient boosting classifier, we show that it is possible to distinguish between different classes of volatility dynamics without relying on parametric calibration.   Through a series of numerical experiments, we demonstrate that the method achieves high classification accuracy across a range of settings, from structurally distinct models to cases involving rough volatility models with closely spaced Hurst parameters. We show that the method remains effective under parameter uncertainty, where each simulated path is drawn with randomly sampled model parameters, and provide a detailed analysis of the misclassification pattern between the Heston and Ornstein--Uhlenbeck models in terms of the volatility of volatility parameter. The results highlight that most of the relevant discriminative information is captured by the first four levels of the signature, while higher-order terms provide only marginal improvements. Overall, the findings support the view that stochastic volatility models can be effectively identified through the geometry of their sample paths.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们提出了一种基于特征签名的框架，用于从观测到的路径数据中识别随机波动性模型类别。通过将波动性轨迹映射到特征空间（利用截断的路径签名），并应用梯度提升分类器，我们证明了无需依赖参数校准即可区分不同类型的波动性动态。通过一系列数值实验，我们证明了该方法在多种情况下都能实现高分类精度，无论是结构上截然不同的模型，还是那些赫斯特参数分布紧密的复杂波动性模型。我们还展示了该方法在参数不确定性下的有效性——在这种情况下，每个模拟路径都是使用随机抽取的模型参数生成的。此外，我们对赫斯顿（Heston）模型与奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克（Ornstein-Uhlenbeck）模型在波动性参数方面的分类错误模式进行了详细分析。研究结果表明，大部分关键的区分信息都包含在特征签名的前四个层次中，而更高阶的项仅能带来微小的改进。总体而言，这些发现支持了这样的观点：随机波动性模型可以通过其样本路径的几何特征被有效识别。。研究方法：模型校准、梯度提升、实验方法、随机过程。

papers.title: Does Financial Trading Smooth Non-Convex Markets?
papers.abstract: In non-convex markets, a competitive equilibrium may fail to exist. This turns out to be an important issue in real-world non-convex auction markets, such as electricity markets, as it complicates pricing and requires the auctioneer to resort to out-of-market discriminatory side payments to sustain an equilibrium. We investigate whether the introduction of convex financial trading induces a smoothing effect, mitigating the issues arising from non-convexities. We develop a two-stage non-convex market model (a forward market followed by a spot market) in which convex financial traders participate in the forward market. Our model predicts that financial trading reduces the magnitude of side payments required to support the cleared allocation. To test the prediction of our model, we examine the introduction of a transaction fee on financial traders in 2020 by PJM, the US's largest electricity market. We show that the substantial decline in financial trading volume caused by this policy coincided with a significant increase in side payments, in line with our theoretical predictions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在非凸市场中，竞争性均衡可能无法实现。这一问题在现实世界的非凸拍卖市场中尤为突出，例如电力市场，因为它会使得定价变得复杂，并迫使拍卖方采取市场外的歧视性附加支付来维持均衡。我们研究了引入凸性金融交易是否能够起到平滑作用，从而缓解非凸性带来的问题。我们构建了一个两阶段非凸市场模型（先为远期市场，后为现货市场），在该模型中凸性金融交易者参与远期市场交易。我们的模型预测，金融交易能够降低维持清算分配所需的附加支付规模。为了验证这一预测，我们分析了美国最大电力市场PJM在2020年对金融交易者征收交易费的影响。研究发现，该政策导致金融交易量大幅下降，同时附加支付也显著增加，这与我们的理论预测一致。。研究方法：均衡模型。
